_comment: Shot list for episode 9, third of four on the Law. 13 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order); reused: episode 7's camp, Henry and Josephus, episode 8's altar, the site's lamp at dawn, the scroll, Brian's Navy photograph and the cane and pew. No imagined scenes are spoken in this series.
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel and its neighbours. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. No modern objects. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
